Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class VendorAssessmentService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.VendorAssessmentService
public class VendorAssessmentService extends Object
Domain service that converts a set of RetrievedSource documents into a structured list of VendorAssessment records by calling the AI model with the vendor-compare prompt template.

The prompt instructs the model to produce one ## VendorName section per vendor found in the sources, each containing structured STRENGTHS:, WEAKNESSES:, RELEVANCE:, and ANALYSIS: lines. This service parses those sections into VendorAssessment records.

This is a pure domain service — no Spring or Lombok imports are used.

  • Method Details

    • assess

      public List<VendorAssessment> assess(String query, List<RetrievedSource> sources, List<SourceCitation> citations, int minVendors, String scoring)
      Assess vendors mentioned in the retrieved sources for the given query. Vendor discovery is left to the AI (free-form mode).
      Parameters:
      query - The original research question.
      sources - Retrieved source documents; may be empty.
      citations - Pre-assembled, deduplicated citation list.
      minVendors - Minimum number of vendor sections to request from the AI.
      scoring - Scoring algorithm: "TF_IDF" or "DOC_FREQUENCY" (default).
      Returns:
      List of VendorAssessment records sorted by relevance descending; empty if sources are empty or no vendor sections are produced by the AI.

    • assess

      public List<VendorAssessment> assess(String query, List<RetrievedSource> sources, List<SourceCitation> citations, int minVendors, String scoring, List<String> vendorNames)
      Assess vendors with optional pre-specified vendor names.

      When vendorNames is non-empty, the AI prompt explicitly lists those vendors and instructs the model to produce a section for each one, even if a vendor has limited evidence in the sources. This eliminates the vendor-discovery failure mode where the AI omits vendors not prominently featured in retrieved articles.

      Parameters:
      query - The original research question.
      sources - Retrieved source documents; may be empty.
      citations - Pre-assembled, deduplicated citation list.
      minVendors - Minimum number of vendor sections to request from the AI.
      scoring - Scoring algorithm: "TF_IDF" or "DOC_FREQUENCY".
      vendorNames - Pre-specified vendor names; empty list falls back to AI discovery.
      Returns:
      List of VendorAssessment records sorted by relevance descending.
